[quote=united_hydronia;60674605][b]Operation Red Falcon: Phase 2[/b]

Now that Hydronia had successfully established two zones within Valddera, it would be time to actually do something with those zones. As agreed with the Valdderan government, the major urban areas would be placed back under local authorities, in exchange for unobstructed access to the highways that ran through the cities. Whilst these cities would be handed back over to the Valdderan government, Hydronian forces would still expand into the surrounding environment to form a secure base form which to launch an assault.

The two Hydronian zones would now be used for two different attacks. Zone 1 in the north would stage an attack on ISV forces in the west, whereas Zone 2 in the south would launch an attack against the new ISV-backed movement that had captured the eastern provinces.

The zone 1 attack would use a strategy of encirclement to isolate pockets of ISV soldiers. Beginning with an overnight incursion into lightly defended ISV-influenced territories, Hydronian forces would roll through the Valdderan countryside in tanks and armoured vehicles. They would use electronic jamming units to disrupt the radar of the ISV, and therefore their vision. Once the ISV had been blinded, surface-to-surface missiles would be fired towards ISV positions, before the survivors are picked off by artillery, machine gunners and snipers. This tactic would be used to surround the ISV and their urban strongholds, before slowly closing in and using superior manpower to crush the ISV. Urban centers would be bombarded with artillery fire until the ISV were killed or gave in, Hydronia has no tolerance for terrorism.

The Zone 2 attack would go differently. The ISV movement in the east would be more heavily fortified, meaning that the resistance Hydronian troops would face would be much harsher. The first thing to be done in the assault would be the surrounding and hopeful destruction of the enclave that had been formed by the ISV. Hydronian forces would initially use similar tactics to the zone 1 offensive, but there would be one alteration. To prevent an ISV attack from the north against Hydronian forces located in the corridor between the areas of the ISV, the army would build up a massive defensive formation along the northern border. This would both protect Hydronia from an attack during the encirclement of the enclave, as well as build a base for the zone 2 army's second attack, which would be against the main territory of the ISV. The encirclement would go the same as the encirclements of the zone 1 offensive, with rounding the ISV forces into central urban areas being the goal.

The new democratic movement that had sprung up in Valddera would surprise Hydronia, but phenomenon like this were to be expected from an unstable country. This also put Hydronia in a very sticky situation. Hydronia has obligations to the legitimate communist government, yet a democratic regime would favour Hydronia's diplomatic interests more. To solve this problem, president Bozkan would alter Hydronia's [i]official[/i] motives. In a speech, he would state that Hydronia is officially in favour of neither the government nor the democratic rebels, reinforcing the fact that Hydronia's sole goal in this war as of now was to rid Erene of the ISV's reign of terror. Whilst Hydronia would continue to cooperate with the Valdderan government, no military aid would be sent to either side. Bozkan would also state that Hydronian forces will try to avoid direct combat with both the red army and the democratic army.

Cobra team would for now refrain from direct military combat against the ISV, their mission would be far more crucial. Stationed in their covert enclave of territory, they would engage in cyber and electronic warfare in an attempt to locate the leader of the ISV, Hassan Al-Amin. Radio communications would be intercepted, jihadist internet forums scoured and cyberattacks launched in an attempt to gain any information on Hassan's whereabouts. Whilst this was happening, cobra team would also take to the skies at night in a stealth helicopter. This helicopter would be fitted with thermal imaging and radar, then flown over Valddera's northern and eastern areas to find possible locations too.

[i]The red falcon watches over valddera...[/i]

[b]EDU Accepts Daesun as Associate Member and Expands Economic Ties with Kianzhou[/b]

[i]Following weeks of extensive negotiations between the government of Daesun, Neudresden, and the nations of Elseyr, the EDU has chosen to accept Daesun as an associate member of the EDU. The Secretary-General of the EDU announced the decision on Monday to the press in the organization's headquarters in the Commonwealth of Jomsland. Chancellor Sebastian Vogt of the Republik told the Budingen Times that This is a historic occasion that will guide the future of both Elseyr and Daesun. In a time of increasing division, deepening economic and security ties between Kianzhou and Elseyr are critical. 

Largely seen by analysts as a significant expansion of the Daesun-Republik Agreement created earlier this year, the accession will see that the economy of Daesun will receive preferred terms from the Elseyr single market, including lowered tariffs, standardized cross-border safety standards, and the digitization of customs to reduce the amount of non-tariff barriers. Additionally, the agreement will allow Daesun to participate in the Elseyran Union Fund, which will financially support the Daesun economy in times of crisis, as well as allow Daesun to contribute to the EUF. Joint innovation projects will also now include Daesun public and private entities with various research and development projects funded by the EDU, from nuclear energy and space exploration to bacteriophage development. 

In security terms, the militaries of the EDU and Daesun will have greater cooperation after the agreement. Intelligence sharing, technology sharing, and the integration of military equipment between the allied militaries will be advanced as Daesun becomes an associate. Another agreement, between the EDU and the Shenlou Economic Cooperation Initiative, will expand the economic ties between Elseyr and Kianzhou. Observers from the EDU will attend meetings of the SECI, work to reduce trade barriers, fund infrastructure projects, and standardize regulations between the Elseyr and Kianzhou economic spheres.[/i]

[b]EDU Fund Authorizes $21 Billion Tallisland Bailout[/b]

[i]As instability in the White Strait increases and fighting has broken out in Tallisland, the Elseyran Union Fund committee has approved a $21 billion bailout to prevent an economic recession in Tallisland. Consisting of both open market operations, lending of last resort, and quantitative easing, the measures aim to use EUF cash to boost the money supply, lower interest rates, prevent major business failures, and stimulate the economy. 

Securities, primarily treasuries from Tallisland banks, will be purchased by the EUF with the purpose of injecting billions into the banking system to cause a decrease in interest rates and boost the money supply. Quantitative easing (QE) will act as a significantly expanded version of the OMOs, with widespread purchase of assets from corporate debt to mortgage-backed securities, to stabilize the economy by flooding the financial system with cash. For any major Tallisland banks with a cash shortage that may prompt a bank run, the EUF will act as a lender of last resort. The distribution of cash to solvent but illiquid financial institutions will work to prevent financial panic, stall bank runs, and restore confidence in the banking system as well as the economy at large.

In a statement on the decision of the Fund Committee, following a four-hour meeting, Chairman Schmidt told reporters "THEP has caused remarkable financial instability in the markets in recent days. Erratic strait shutdowns, tariffs and sanctions by the government of Thyven have created significant short term uncertainty not just for the EDU but Erene at large. While this continues, the EUF will work to stabilize allied economies."[/i]

[b]The ULR raises concerns around the EDU's and Daesun's expanding cooperation[/b]

Recently, the Elseyran Defense Union (EDU) accepted Daesun as an associate member into the Union, expanding the earlier agreement the nation had with the Neue Republik. The acceptance has given Daesun preferred terms in the EDU such as lowered tariffs and has even allowed Daesun to access the union's emergency fund, giving the large nation something to lean on in the case it is hit with a crisis. These are all relatively good pieces of news for the nation, the real attention of Lavia has been put on the other parts of the agreement. 

Lavia recently signed a trade and exchange deal with Daesun, allowing them to purchase and sell multiple things to us. Chief among these are proprietary nuclear energy and research technologies, weapons, armored vehicles, military aircraft, shipbuilding techniques, and very importantly, plutonium. The Kianzhoun nation becoming an associate member with the EDU also include Daesun in joint projects such as nuclear energy research as well as integrating Daesun's military further towards the EDU standard. Not only does this potentially expose critical Lavian technologies planned to be sent to Daesun to the prying eyes of the EDU, an alliance which seems to see itself more and more as the international police, challenging our THEP allies while at it, as well as supporting the oppressive Tallislandic government contrary to their own stated mission.

As of recent, many experts who have already been sent to Daesun have been ordered to stop working, and important technologies which were bound for the nation now sit idle in port, waiting for a decision to be made. The Lavian government has sent an official complaint to the Daesunite government, requesting a rewrite to the recent trade deal which would involve the Directorate of International Intelligence (DII) overlooking all usage, transportation, storage and study of proprietary technologies deemed critical to Lavian security, as well as guarantees that Daesun would not share any information about the technologies, military arms and vehicles agreed bought under the agreement with the EDU, and they will not provide the union any nuclear material purchased from Lavia in any way. While consumer goods and resources remain in trade, the holding of experts and tech from Daesun holds them to either agree to the wanted rewrite or loose anticipated critical technologies and may further lose entire parts of the deal.

Finally, Daesun's military bases across the ULR will be bared from access to all EDU troops and vehicles, announced by the Military Command of the Republic. Not posing an immediate issue, this can become a hot piece of contention as Daesun integrates further with the EDU, requiring the nation to station potentially older equipment on such bases to comply with such requirements as they replace their vehicles and weaponry to comply with the union's own military requirements. Daesun has shown they are willing to work with Lavia, but the nation waits to see if they will accept Lavia's demands, or look to the EDU to fill the withheld technologies.

[spoiler=[b]Marineinfantrie Operations in Tallisland[/b]][b]Anti-Ship[/b]

The primary goal of the Republik Marineinfantrie stationed in Tallisland, now around 30,000 strong, would be to completely halt the AWN landings on the islands. Using the NMESIS systems brought in by the amphibious ready groups, the Marineinfantrie fire salvoes of naval strike missiles towards the AWN craft as they move towards the islands. Its low radar cross-section and sea-skimming qualities would work to minimize interception. Additionally, the onboard infrared imaging would allow the NSMs to track their targets in the cluttered littoral environments while allowing them to make unpredictable terminal-stage evasive maneuvers. For particularly defended targets, the HIMAR systems of the Marineinfantrie, based on the expeditionary bases established by the ARGs, kick in. Armed with the naval variant of the precision strike missile, the ballistic anti-ship missiles travel at hypersonic speeds to intercept their targets. While based on the same launch platform as their older counterparts, the missiles allow the HIMARS to double their capacity, allowing for significantly more launches against heavily defended surface targets. 

Both on the surface and underwater, the UUVs and USVs of the Hochdeutsche Navy work to dismantle and slow down the AWN. The small craft, using the cluttered littoral passages and their small frames to their advantage, swarm the AWN landing ships to overwhelm their defences. The HN-1, utilizing a warhead built into its body, works to try to slam into the ships of the AWN while other USVs fire off Switchblade-600 loitering munitions towards the AWN ships. Other C2 USVs work to monitor the situation and allow the swarm to work autonomously should communications with the human operators be jammed. Underwater, the Manta Ray UUVs, hiding on the seabed, activate. Using its modular bay, the swarms of UUVs fire off torpedoes into the undersides of the AWN landing ships to prevent them from being able to access the islands. 

From the skies, the Republic's B-25 EX stealth bombers work to deliver their payloads of 500-lb QUICKSINK JDAMs onto the AWN fleet below. Each GPS and INS-guided bomb explodes near the hull of the ships, essentially acting as an air-launched torpedo. While sized down from its larger counterparts, the 500-lb version allows the B25-EXs to engage up to 80 targets at once. From the skies above the homeland of the Neue Republik, C-17 cargo ships take off. In their back, they are loaded with rapid dragon cells. Within the missile cells lies the HAFs new FAMM, or a set of low-cost cruise missiles meant to saturate enemy defenses. Each of the cargo planes is capable of launching 48 FAMM cruise missiles. Guided by an onboard autonomous system, the hordes of missiles coordinate with each other to locate, approach, and hit targets in-flight. 

Should any AWN forces manage to get onto the islands, they would be under constant bombardment from the Tomahawk cruise missiles provided by the submarine fleet of the HN. The Marineinfantrie would also carry out landings on the Szulban islands following extensive bombardment to seize and secure them for the joint-EDU coalition. 

[b]Airstrikes[/b] 

Across the country, the HAF would carry out precision air strikes using its UAVs. Using a mix of agents on the ground, satellite imagery, and reconnaissance drones, the intelligence agencies would work to relentlessly track down members of the socialist and Young Tallisland insurgents, as well as Grunder Industries corporate leaders known to be supplying the insurgents. Using Hellfire missiles, the HAF would work to cut off the head of the snake by carrying out air strikes against the leaders of the insurgents and their backers en masse. The goal would be to disorient the insurgents, weaken their attacks and coordination while working to cause internal power struggles. 

From the HN in the Nestor Sea, payloads of Tomahawk cruise missiles would be launched towards the west of Tallisland and the Ofenhind peninsula to strike key targets including the insurgent-held naval office, rebel arms depots, and their command centers. Across the west and Ofenhind, the B25-EX stealth bombers from the Republik would relentlessly bomb the armed insurgents with GBU-31 2,000-lb JDAMs. Particularly entrenched rebel positions, mostly the air fields used to field their fighter jets, would be hit with the Republic's air-launched ballistic missiles. The D-5 line would travel at Mach 10 towards their targets, fired by J-16s from up to 1,500 km away. To ground the insurgent jets, the aviation fuel, maintenance centers, and runways in Breckaloo and Aardbuer would all be targets of the ALBMs. The LTAMDS sensors deployed to Tallisland by the HA, which provide 360-degree coverage, kick in to saturate the airspace and bring down the insurgent jets. Using the Rakete SAMs, the sensors track up to 100 targets using their phased array, guiding the missile's hit-to-kill mechanisms. From the carrier air wing based in the Nestor Ocean, the J-35s take off. Using their new AIM-174B anti-air missiles, the aircraft engage the insurgent jets at up to 300 km away at BVR. 

[b]On the Move[/b]

Following the bombardment of the Ofenhind peninsula from air and sea, the Marineinfantrie would land on the friendly-controlled east of the peninsula. Pushing westward with air support, their goal would be to completely seize Ofenhind and occupy the territory to prevent further aid for the insurgents.[/spoiler]

Using a mix of agents on the ground, satellite imagery, and reconnaissance drones, the intelligence agencies would work to relentlessly track down members of the socialist and Young Tallisland insurgents, as well as Grunder Industries corporate leaders known to be supplying the insurgents. Using Hellfire missiles, the HAF would work to cut off the head of the snake by carrying out air strikes against the leaders of the insurgents and their backers en masse. The goal would be to disorient the insurgents, weaken their attacks and coordination while working to cause internal power struggles. 

From the HN in the Nestor Sea, payloads of Tomahawk cruise missiles would be launched towards the west of Tallisland and the Ofenhind peninsula to strike key targets including the insurgent-held naval office, rebel arms depots, and their command centers. Across the west and Ofenhind, the B25-EX stealth bombers from the Republik would relentlessly bomb the armed insurgents with GBU-31 2,000-lb JDAMs. Particularly entrenched rebel positions, mostly the air fields used to field their fighter jets, would be hit with the Republic's air-launched ballistic missiles. The D-5 line would travel at Mach 10 towards their targets, fired by J-16s from up to 1,500 km away. To ground the insurgent jets, the aviation fuel, maintenance centers, and runways in Breckaloo and Aardbuer would all be targets of the ALBMs. The LTAMDS sensors deployed to Tallisland by the HA, which provide 360-degree coverage, kick in to saturate the airspace and bring down the insurgent jets. Using the Rakete SAMs, the sensors track up to 100 targets using their phased array, guiding the missile's hit-to-kill mechanisms. From the carrier air wing based in the Nestor Ocean, the J-35s take off. Using their new AIM-174B anti-air missiles, the aircraft engage the insurgent jets at up to 300 km away at BVR. 

[b]On the Move[/b]

Following the bombardment of the Ofenhind peninsula from air and sea, the Marineinfantrie would land on the friendly-controlled east of the peninsula. Pushing westward with air support, their goal would be to completely seize Ofenhind and occupy the territory to prevent further aid for the insurgents.[/spoiler][/quote]
